description.value:
Homo mortuus redivivus - Reanimate / Post-Mortem Type, corporate/common name; Revs, Deaders, Rotters, Ghosts (late-stage) on the street. No one starts life as a Revenant - they are made: a person who died with a burning purpose (vengeance, an oath, a debt, a refusal) and rose again sustained by will rather than blood. They keep their memories and personality from life. A Revenant is embodied undead at first and only slowly loses corporeality as they endure death after death.

Attributes: +1 Resolve, +1 Insight, and -1 to either Physique or Presence (chosen at creation - withered muscle or unsettling deadness). Obeys normal tier attribute caps.

Free at creation (Tier 5): the signature Undying Return, plus Deathless Physiology (split into its two halves - survival immunities and grave-warded resistance), Deathsight (Glowing Eyes), Former Life, and Decay Stage (Fleshbound). Unified species, no subtypes.

Nine BP-purchased Species Options span utility, defense, movement, and social play, gated across all tiers - capped by Wraithform Mastery at Tier 1. A tier-gated Decay ladder carries the Revenant from rotting flesh (Fleshbound, T5-T4) to hardened bone (Withered/Skeletal, T3) to incorporeal spirit (Spectral, T2-T1).

RevAdvFreeTrait0.name: Signature + Free Traits
RevAdvFreeTrait0.description: You gain the Revenant signature trait Undying Return and the free package: Deathless Physiology, Grave-Warded Flesh, Deathsight (Glowing Eyes), Former Life, and Decay Stage (Fleshbound).

RevAdvOptionBP00.name: Species Options (spend BP)
RevAdvOptionBP00.description: Optionally spend BP on a tier-gated Revenant option. Sabbat takes Deathspeaker (2 BP, Tier 5). Each option lists its BP cost and minimum tier.
